hero.title: A learning experience that adapts to every learner
hero.subtitle: The AI Tutor understands what each learner is reading and provides real-time, contextual guidance that improves comprehension, engagement, and completion rates.

definition.label: Definition · Hyperpersonalized Learning
definition.text: Hyperpersonalized Learning in LearnPack means that every learner receives real-time adaptive support from the AI Tutor. It tailors explanations, clarifies concepts, and guides understanding directly inside the learning experience.

uniqueValue.title: Support that feels personal, at scale
bullets: Responds to the learner's exact confusion
Adjusts depth and clarity of explanations
Tailors examples to each role or objective

howItWorks.title: Learning that reacts to the learner

step1.title: Reads the moment
step1.description: The AI Tutor interprets context: what the learner is reading, previous attempts, and moments of hesitation.

step2.title: Responds intelligently
step2.description: It provides clarifications, examples, or questions based on level, history, and the learner's objective.

step3.title: Guides the learning path
step3.description: As the learner advances, the AI Tutor adjusts the guidance to strengthen long-term understanding.

examples.title: What hyperpersonalization looks like in practice

scenario1.title: Simpler explanations
scenario1.text: A learner asks for a simpler explanation. The AI Tutor rewrites the paragraph instantly.

scenario2.title: Role-based examples
scenario2.text: A sales employee requests an industry example. The AI Tutor adapts automatically.

scenario3.title: Guided reasoning
scenario3.text: The AI Tutor guides reasoning instead of just giving the solution.

impact.title: A measurable difference in how people learn
impact.text: Organizations using LearnPack see learners progressing with higher confidence and fewer blockers. Training programs supported by the AI Tutor achieve up to double the completion rate and significantly lower dropout levels, with clearer understanding and stronger skill application.
impact.note: Metrics based on aggregated performance across training centers and enterprise environments.
